description: Frozen copies of Table import 2's recipe-import parsers, for parity tests and benchmark baselines. Undo the listed edits of a 'verbatim' or 'copy' file (in reverse order) to get the baseline file byte for byte (checked by tests/parity/provenance.test.ts).

edits.text:

edits.why: the frozen copy of url.ts is ./link.ts

edits.to:

edits.why: the package has no decimal.js dependency and never imports Table modules: D comes from ./decimal (BigInt), the unit table from ./units

edits.text:

files.note: Parser body textually identical to the baseline (every line after the import line).

kept: UNITS table (same keys, dimensions and factors, same order)
edits.why: only what the frozen ingredient-line parser imports; no decimal.js in the package

edits.replaces: export const D = Decimal.clone({ precision: 40, rounding: Decimal.ROUND_HALF_UP })
edits.why: a BigInt rational stand-in for the decimal.js operations the parser uses; differential tests in tests/parity/decimal.test.ts

liveTableObserved.note: Table's own ingredient-line parser moved past the baseline in main 8e6bd6e (import overhaul). The frozen copies stay at cb7b56e; parity with the live module is only checked while it is still the baseline file. tests/parity/baseline-snapshot.json keeps proving the frozen engine's outputs are Table import 2's.
